units.source_text: 他是个臭名远扬的匪徒，他叫多襄丸。

en.t: He is a notorious bandit, and his name is Tajomaru.

units.source_text: 我抓到他的时候，他躺在粟田口的石桥上痛苦呻吟，我估计他是从马背上摔下来的。

en.t: When I caught him, he was lying on the stone bridge at Awataguchi groaning in pain, so I suppose he had fallen from his horse.

units.source_text: 大概是昨儿晚上初更左右。

en.t: It was probably around the first watch last night.

units.source_text: 上一次他就险些落网，可惜被他跑了。

en.t: The last time, he almost fell into our hands, but unfortunately he got away.

units.source_text: 上一次他穿的也是浅蓝色上衣，腰里别着佩刀。

en.t: That time too, he was wearing a pale blue jacket and had a sword tucked at his waist.

units.source_text: 你看看，现在他不光带刀，还带弓箭。

en.t: Look at him now: he has not only a sword, but a bow and arrows as well.

units.source_text: 被害的男人也带了刀和弓箭……那我可以肯定凶手就是多襄丸。

en.t: The murdered man also carried a sword and a bow and arrows... then I can be certain the killer was Tajomaru.

units.source_text: 皮弓、黑漆箭壶、十七支鹰羽箭——这都是被害男子的东西。

en.t: The leather bow, the black-lacquered quiver, and the seventeen hawk-feathered arrows were all the murdered man's belongings.

units.source_text: 是的，就像你认为的那样，他骑的那匹马正是一匹桃花马，且剃了马鬃。

en.t: Yes, just as you think, the horse he was riding was indeed a roan, and its mane had been clipped.

units.source_text: 这就是所谓的恶有恶报吧，这凶手被马甩到地上了。

en.t: This must be what they call evil bringing its own punishment: the killer was thrown to the ground by the horse.

units.source_text: 当时马在石桥附近吃青芒，缰绳就拖在地上。

en.t: At the time, the horse was eating green miscanthus near the stone bridge, with its reins dragging on the ground.
